articles.title: U.S. CFTC seeks event contract definitions that may defy states' gambling claims
articles.snippet: As it battles with states over prediction markets, the CFTC sent two related rules on swaps definitions for White House review.

articles.title: Cardano tapped by Brazil’s state oil giant to track cleaner jet fuel and diesel
articles.snippet: Petrobras is testing the blockchain in two research projects aimed at preventing emissions benefits from being counted twice and tracing fuel data across production and use.

articles.title: Bitget hackers move $4 million into Zcash’s private pool, making funds harder to trace
articles.snippet: Three transfers pushed about 15% of the stolen ZEC into Ironwood, where payments hide their senders, recipients and amounts.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs draw $6.3B in Q3 as BTC price rises nearly 43%
articles.snippet: Bitcoin gained 42.71% in Q3, its best third-quarter performance since 2017, as US spot ETFs attracted $6.34 billion in net inflows.

articles.title: CFTC seeks to define event contracts as swaps amid prediction market fight
articles.snippet: The classification could assist the CFTC’s claim that it has exclusive federal jurisdiction over event contracts offered on regulated prediction markets.
